items.title: How does conflict risk grow as each branch touches more of the file?
items.description: Illustrative model, not a precise simulation: assumes each branch's changed lines are scattered randomly and independently across the file (real edits cluster, so this overstates true randomness — but it shows the real shape of the effect). With Alex and Sam each touching a given percentage of a file's lines, drag either slider to see how many lines end up genuinely conflicting versus how many total lines get touched across both branches.
items.compute: const ours = Math.round(params.fileLines * (params.oursChangedPercent / 100)); const theirs = Math.round(params.fileLines * (params.theirsChangedPercent / 100)); const expectedConflicts = Math.round(params.fileLines * (params.oursChangedPercent / 100) * (params.theirsChangedPercent / 100)); const touchedUnion = ours + theirs - expectedConflicts; return { expectedConflicts, touchedUnion };

outputs.label: Total lines touched by either branch
